key_insight: A pure LLM can match strong multimodal models on hard plane-geometry reasoning when it is paired with a diagram-to-symbol parser and a formal symbolic solver.
engineering_relevance: The work suggests a modular, interpretable alternative to end-to-end multimodal geometry systems, reducing hallucinations and improving transparency for theorem-proving-style tasks.
method: Geometric Vision Parser converts diagrams into symbolic geometric facts.
Symbolic Solver performs formal deductions from the parsed symbols.
LLM coordinates the process to produce clear, human-like reasoning.
evidence_signal: The authors evaluate on a new benchmark built from challenging 2025 Chinese Zhongkao geometry problems to test novelty and deeper deductive reasoning.
watch_item: Performance may depend heavily on the quality of diagram parsing and the completeness of symbolic representations, which can fail on ambiguous visuals or noisy inputs.
paper_title: From Symbolic Perception to Logical Deduction: A Framework for Guiding Language Models in Geometric Reasoning
